units.source_text: 明石道人尊敬源氏公子，自己不敢接近他，住在隔远的一间边屋里。

en.t: The Akashi monk revered Prince Genji and did not dare approach him himself, so he lived in a detached side room some distance away.

units.source_text: 然而心中希望朝夕亲近他，觉得如此疏远很不快意。

en.t: Yet in his heart he wished to be near him morning and evening, and he found such distance deeply unsatisfying.

units.source_text: 他总想找个机会向他提出心中夙愿，因此更加虔诚地向神佛祈祷。

en.t: He was always looking for a chance to tell Genji the long cherished wish in his heart, and so he prayed all the more devoutly to the gods and buddhas.

units.source_text: 这位道人虽然年已六十，身体却很清健。

en.t: Although this monk was already sixty years old, his body was still very healthy and vigorous.

units.source_text: 为了朝夕勤修佛法，形容略见消瘦。

en.t: Because he diligently practiced the Buddhist teachings morning and evening, his appearance showed a slight thinness.

units.source_text: 虽然有时不免顽固昏愦，但想是出身高贵之故吧，见闻广博，懂得许多古代掌故。

en.t: Although at times he could not help being stubborn and muddled, perhaps because he came from noble birth, he was widely experienced and knew many ancient anecdotes and precedents.

units.source_text: 并且态度大方，毫无猥琐之相。

en.t: Moreover, his manner was generous and dignified, with no trace of pettiness or vulgarity.

units.source_text: 有时源氏公子召见，他便向公子讲述种种古代逸事，亦可稍慰公子之岑寂。

en.t: When Prince Genji sometimes summoned him, he would tell the prince various tales from old times, which also helped somewhat to ease Genji's loneliness.

units.source_text: 源氏公子年来公私都很忙碌，无暇听取世间种种掌故，

en.t: In recent years Prince Genji had been busy with both public and private affairs and had had no leisure to hear the many old stories of the world,

units.source_text: 今有明石道人娓娓话旧，颇感兴趣，他想：“我倘不到这地方，不遇见这个人，倒很可惜了。”

en.t: but now that the Akashi monk spoke so engagingly of the past, Genji found it quite interesting and thought, If I had not come to this place and met this man, it would have been a real pity.

units.source_text: 明石道人虽然渐渐与源氏公子熟悉，但因公子气宇尊严，令人望而生畏，

en.t: Although the Akashi monk gradually became familiar with Prince Genji, the prince's bearing was so majestic and dignified that it inspired awe in those who looked at him,

units.source_text: 所以胸中纵有打算，见了面却勇气全无，不能随心所欲地将愿望说出。

en.t: and so, even though the monk had plans in his heart, when he met Genji face to face he lost all courage and could not freely speak of his wish.

units.source_text: 因此常常焦虑痛惜，只能与夫人共话，相对叹息。

en.t: Because of this, he was often anxious and regretful, and could only talk it over with his wife as the two sat facing each other and sighed.

units.source_text: 小姐本人呢，生在这穷乡僻壤，即使要找一个普通身份的夫婿，也没有看得上眼的人物。

en.t: As for the young lady herself, born in this poor and remote place, even if she sought a husband of ordinary rank, there was no one she found worthy of notice.

units.source_text: 如今看见世间竟有这等高贵英俊的美男子，但觉自己身世微贱，决没有高攀的资格。

en.t: Now that she had seen that such a noble and handsome man existed in the world, she only felt that her own station was too humble and that she had absolutely no right to aspire so high.

units.source_text: 她听见父母作此打算，认为这是妄想，反比没有这件事以前更加悲伤了。

en.t: When she heard that her parents were making such plans, she thought it was a delusion and became even sadder than she had been before the matter arose.
